notes.title: Framing Dawes - AMA Session on Discord
notes.content:
I'm hosting an 'Ask Me Anything' (AMA) over on my Discord channel and I hope to see you there - Sunday 21st June 5pm to 6pm BST (12pm to 1pm EST)

Click the link below to join the Jinx-It Games Server. I've set up a specific  'steam-festival-ama' channel especially for it.

Jinx-It Games Discord Server 


Some of you may have noticed I've removed the live stream event. Urgh, it's disappointing and frustrating as I was really looking forward to it. I live in the middle of nowhere, I mean there are roads and the odd path and lots of fields, but my internet connection is absolutely terrible. The test run resulted in 99% of it skipping, so it's just not feasible.
I might try and record me streaming the demo some other date, if you'd like to see that, but unfortunately for the festival, it's not working. I'm sorry. I do hope you'll join me on Sunday for this Q&A session though. I might share some sneak peek new artwork!

Thanks for your understanding and I hope you enjoy the demo. 

Stay safe <3

Caroline
Jinx-It Games
